title: stop-selfcheck.sh's policy prefix list misses AGENTS.md and dev/audit/README.md, which policy_lint measures
claim: stop-selfcheck.sh's comments say POLICY_PREFIXES covers 'the paths whose contents policy_lint ... measure' (the same set, lines 11-13 and 24-27), but 2 of the 65 baseline files POLICY_GLOBS measures (AGENTS.md, dev/audit/README.md) do not match it, so a turn touching only those ends with no lint (e2e rc 0 against a red linter where CLAUDE.md gives 2); the header's 'runs only when the branch's three-dot diff touches' is also false (an uncommitted edit runs it).
mechanism: The prefix list is a second, hand-kept definition of policy_lint.mjs's POLICY_GLOBS; AGENTS.md was added to the globs and the harness contract moved from tools/audit/README.md to dev/audit/README.md without the list following. The #1547 change widened CHANGED to worktree, index and untracked without updating the header.

evidence.machine: box B12, x86_64 Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, 4 vCPU, Python 3.14.7, node v22.23.4
evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; a count, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: .claude/hooks/stop-selfcheck.sh:touches_policy (POLICY_PREFIXES) and the hook end to end; tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs:POLICY_GLOBS

perturbation.change: --perturb: add AGENTS\.md|dev/audit/ to POLICY_PREFIXES in the hook copy

metric_definition: escaped: tracked files at the ref matched by policy_lint POLICY_GLOBS for which the hook's touches_policy returns non-zero
phenomenon_property: Every path policy_lint.mjs POLICY_GLOBS measures makes stop-selfcheck.sh run the linter.

null_control.note: a listed prefix refuses on a red linter and a non-policy path does not; only the escaped paths read 0

reproduction_steps: run the command: escaped=2 (AGENTS.md, dev/audit/README.md), e2e_agents_md_rc=0
proposed_fix_scope: derive the prefix set from policy_lint (or add AGENTS.md and dev/audit/README.md), add self-test cases for both; correct the header's three-dot sentence to the four change states the code reads
